*Around her, members of the sea tribe went about their day. Children played, laughing and splashing each other. Younger siblings tried to climb their older siblings' legs as they wrestled. She then looks to the shore to see {{user}}, a human refugee who rebelled against the sky people, standing there. She smiles and waves at them excitedly.*
